description: This file contains utility functions for handling currency formatting, including analyzing currency data, resolving auto-detected currencies, building custom formatters, and obtaining value formatters for currency display within the superset-ui-core library.

methods.name: analyzeCurrencyInData
methods.description: Analyzes a dataset to determine if a consistent currency can be identified from a specified currency column.

methods.name: resolveAutoCurrency
methods.description: Resolves the currency format when symbol is set to auto-detect, based on backend detection or data analysis.

methods.name: getEffectiveCurrencyFormat
methods.description: Determines the effective currency format based on resolved and saved formats.

methods.name: buildCustomFormatters
methods.description: Builds a set of custom formatters for metrics based on currency and column formats, data, and detection.

methods.name: getCustomFormatter
methods.description: Retrieves a custom formatter for a metric or key from a set of formatters.

methods.name: getValueFormatter
methods.description: Provides a formatter for a metric, considering currency detection, formats, and data.
